name: Medicine MMI + Clinical Reasoning
blurb: A residency-style Multiple Mini Interview: short, focused stations on communication, ethics, and teamwork, plus a clinical-reasoning case.

rounds.title: MMI Station: Breaking Bad News
rounds.focus: Communication station: empathy, clarity, and checking understanding. Assess how they deliver difficult information and respond to emotion.

rounds.title: MMI Station: Ethical Dilemma
rounds.focus: Ethics station: identify the competing principles, reason through options, and commit to a defensible course of action.

rounds.title: MMI Station: Teamwork
rounds.focus: Teamwork station: collaboration, handling conflict with colleagues, and prioritizing patient care.

rounds.title: Clinical Reasoning: Chest Pain
rounds.focus: Structured differential, targeted history and workup, and a safe disposition. Probe red-flag reasoning.
